vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm plants themself in front of you. "This isn't working. You know it, I know it. Say it out loud."
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Rebecca, Rafael, Boris and Giulia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Rebecca, Rafael, Boris, Giulia are hurt.
🛡️ Rebecca, Boris, Mateo and Daniyar met them at the door — 4 put down. Rebecca, Boris, Mateo are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rebecca just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Rebecca, Rafael, Boris, Giulia and Daniyar met them at the door — 5 put down. Rebecca, Rafael, Boris, Giulia, Daniyar are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sarah just put down The Audit... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giulia just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."

regDeaths.name: stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
a shadow moving wrong against the sun
a crow that watches too long and blinks too little
